picks.name: Mick Harris
picks.bio: UK sound artist known for Scorn, Napalm Death and Painkiller. "Culvert Dubs Session 7" (May 1, 2026) is an 8-track 2xLP on L.I.E.S. Records, part of his ongoing dub-influenced Culvert series.
picks.why_listen: Heavyweight, cavernous dub from an artist with decades of extreme-music pedigree -- useful for a low-end-driven, atmospheric stretch that isn't quite techno or reggae.

picks.name: Piero Umiliani, Berto Pisano, Armando Trovajoli, Luis Bacalov
picks.source_note: New volume on Right Tempo / Mono Jazz / Easy Tempo, same series as the Vol.3 pick already featured (Aug 19).
picks.bio: "Easy Tempo Experience Vol.4 - THE SIXTH SENSE" (March 13, 2026) draws from classic Italian soundtrack and library catalog work by Umiliani, Pisano, Trovajoli and Bacalov, reworked and carefully selected by a global crew of producer friends.
picks.why_listen: Another entry in the same reworked-library-music series as your existing Easy Tempo pick -- cinematic breaks and grooves that sample and mix well.

picks.name: Spoek Mathambo
picks.bio: Already in your library. South African artist who coined the term "Township Tech." "Pass the Salad" (August 20, 2026) is a new single on his own Teka Music.
picks.why_listen: Fresh material from an artist already in your rotation -- worth checking against his older tracks you already play to see how his sound has moved.
